svg.title: Empty annular stages give zero; nonempty ones have exactly the refined geometry. Finitely many sectors and components preserve uniformity. Because P n≥0 aγ n = (1−2−γ)−1, their complete terms are absolutely summable in integral norm. CE9’s eventual germ equality and proper-normal Haar- null exceptions identify the sum almost everywhere with the unsliced expression. More precisely the terms sum in the Banach space L1(E; X), since the sum of norms is finite. Absolute integral-norm summability also supplies the almost everywhere pointwise sum; uniqueness identifies the same integrable function, without an unproved dominating function.
